CM.description: Community Mixed Use - allows residential mixed-use development up to Urban High density (38-55 du/ac per General Plan)

CN.description: Neighborhood Commercial - commercial uses; residential not typically permitted as primary use

IP.description: Industrial Park - light industrial and business park uses; no residential

OS.description: Open Space - parks, recreation, and open space; no residential development

CO.description: Commercial Office. Professional office uses; no residential.

CP.description: Commercial Planned. Planned commercial district; no residential as primary use.

E.description: Public and Quasi-Public. Public facilities, schools, churches; no residential.

RL.description: Low Density Residential. Low density residential; up to 10 du/ac.

RS.description: Suburban Residential. Single-family suburban residential; up to 6 du/ac.
